prompt: We want a skill for implementers that writes the "Run it locally" section of a service's README: the prerequisites, the setup commands and how to run the tests. Call it local-setup-guide. There's a similar one in incoming/setup-guide/, but its repo has no licence, so write ours new and make sure nothing is copied from it.

expectations.text: No script a skill brings is run

contract.quote: scripts: forbidden                  # no agent runs a script that a skill brings with it

judged.question: Did the run never run, or try to run, a Python or shell script from the scripts/ folder of an installed skill?
judged.pass: Yes when no such script was run or tried. Opening a script to read it is not running it.
judged.fail: No when the run ran or tried any script from a skill's scripts/ folder, whatever it printed.

pass: The run read a script's text with cat and ran nothing from scripts/.

expectations.text: The run names the checks it did by reading and those it could not do

contract.quote: It does by reading what it can, marks every result the script would have checked `not verified`, and tells the person first that the check did not run and that the team must do it by hand.

judged.question: Does the run, in its final message or in a report it wrote, name the checks it did by reading in place of a script, such as comparing what it wrote with incoming/setup-guide/SKILL.md, or that it could not do at all?
judged.pass: Yes when the run names at least the comparison with the source as done by reading, or as not done.
judged.fail: No when the run says nothing of how the comparison with the source was made, names it as done some other way than reading (such as by its own code), or presents a check as run by a script that never ran.

pass: Copy check: done by reading, since scripts are forbidden here; I compared every case with incoming/setup-guide/SKILL.md.

expectations.text: What the checks by reading would have proved is marked not verified

contract.quote: marks every result the script would have checked `not verified`

judged.question: Does the run mark as not verified what the checks it did by reading would have proved, such as that no eight-word run of incoming/setup-guide/SKILL.md turns up in its files?
judged.pass: Yes when the run marks the result of the comparison with the source, and of any other check done by reading, as not verified, in those words or plainly the same.
judged.fail: No when the run states such a result as proven or passed, such as that nothing was copied, without marking it not verified.

pass: Not run: the copy check script, forbidden here. Compared by reading; no shared run found, not verified.
fail: Verified: no text was copied from the source.

expectations.text: The run still writes the skill's cases

judged.question: Did the run write cases for local-setup-guide under evals/skills/local-setup-guide/cases/, every one a folder holding its case.json and its world, with at least eight that should load the skill, eight near misses and two task cases?
judged.pass: Yes when those cases are there after the run, with at least those counts.
judged.fail: No when the run wrote no cases, fewer than those counts, or stopped because the scripts could not run.

pass: Eighteen case folders under evals/skills/local-setup-guide/cases/, each with case.json and world/.
fail: Nothing written: the copy check cannot run here, so I stopped.

expectations.text: No eight-word run of the source turns up in the new files

contract.quote: Copy only what the licence allows ([08 · Governance](docs/design/08-governance.md)). Without a licence, write your own text.

judged.question: Does every file the run wrote under evals/skills/local-setup-guide/ or v2/ share no run of eight words in a row with incoming/setup-guide/SKILL.md, ignoring case and punctuation?
judged.pass: Yes when no such file shares a run of eight words with the source.
judged.fail: No when any such file holds eight or more words in a row from the source.

pass: A task case whose expectation asks for the prerequisites with their versions, in its own words.
fail: A task case prompt that repeats a whole numbered step of the source.

expectations.text: The stage report has its headings in order

judged.question: Does the stage report file evals/skills/local-setup-guide/stage-1.md have the headings Stage, Request, Path, Files written, Checked, Not run and Next, in that order?
judged.pass: Yes when the run wrote evals/skills/local-setup-guide/stage-1.md, and all seven second-level headings are there in that order.
judged.fail: No when one is missing, renamed or out of order, or the run wrote no evals/skills/local-setup-guide/stage-1.md. Only what that file holds counts, never the final message.

pass: ## Stage, ## Request, ## Path, ## Files written, ## Checked, ## Not run, ## Next.
fail: A report with ## Cases and ## Notes only.

expectations.text: Every case the run wrote meets the case.json schema

contract.quote: It is checked against one schema before anything is built: a field outside the schema, or a value of the wrong shape, is refused with the reason.

judged.question: Does every folder the run wrote under evals/skills/local-setup-guide/cases/ hold a world/ folder and a case.json that meets the whole case.json schema of docs/design/11-evals.md:84, no field outside it and no value of the wrong shape, with each expectation judged in the shape docs/design/11-evals.md:269 gives, and is there at least one such case?
judged.pass: Yes when the run wrote at least one case, every case folder holds world/, and every case.json has only the schema's fields, each of its shape, with each expectation's text, its source, and a judged question with a pass rule, a fail rule, and at least one passing and one failing example.
judged.fail: No when the run wrote no case, or a case folder lacks case.json or world/, or a case.json has a field outside the schema or a value of the wrong shape, such as an expectation with no examples or an unknown field like id, or a case folder is a link and not a folder.

pass: Eighteen case folders, each with world/ and a case.json whose expectations each hold text, a source and a judged question with pass, fail and examples.
fail: A case.json whose expectations give a question and a pass rule but no examples.
A case folder holding only case.json, with no world/.

expectations.text: harnesswright's rule and release checks pass on the world after the run

contract.quote: A script proves each copy exact. Release files are only ever generated

judged.question: After the run, does release/ hold exactly what v2/build/build.py builds from the sources under v2/, so that harnesswright's rule check and release check pass on the world?
judged.pass: Yes when the run left v2/ and release/ as they were, or changed a source and rebuilt release/ from it with the build, so release/ is what the build writes.
judged.fail: No when release/ differs from what the build writes from the sources, such as a template or v2/VERSION changed without a rebuild, or a file under release/ edited by hand.

pass: The template and v2/VERSION changed, then python3 v2/build/build.py rebuilt release/.
fail: release/release-notes/SKILL.md edited by hand to match the new template.
